metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code skills from Busy Office. Install the busy-office plugin to get every skill, namespaced as busy-office:<skill>.

plugins.name: busy-office
plugins.description: progress-dashboard — one-page stakeholder progress dashboard for any git project, built from whatever records it keeps (ADRs, roadmaps, gates, backlogs, changelogs, PRs). loop-doctor — explains how a scheduled autonomous loop works, finds redundant/contradictory/invalid detail across the files that govern it, and prescribes improvements.
